Message.text: Mirrormere: a lake so still it holds the whole sky. The road runs east to a landing. Deep water is a wall; shallow water only slows you. Keep to the shore.
Reedwater Landing. Across the water, a drowned cathedral and its tower. The road north follows the shore to a village that kept its roofs and lost its floors.
Stillwater Village, flooded to the knees. The Drowned stand in the streets as if waiting. Slow ones, but they grab. The chief's house is the largest.
A stair runs down into the lake here and does not come up. Something rings a bell below. A sluice is down there too, they say.
A rowboat, moored behind the village. The water past it is only chest deep, and an islet sits in the middle.
The Reed Marsh. The green water is Blight: it eats at you while you stand in it. Antidote and clearwater are for after. Something moves in the reeds.
Ossuary Stair. The crypt below is sealed by fallen stone. The causeway to the cathedral runs from the east end of this shore.
The causeway to the Drowned Cathedral. Bell Acolytes keep it. Their bells ring the water. On a quiet day you can hear the choir inside.
The nave's doors are open and the air in them is thick as fog. Whatever sings in there will not let you leave until one of you falls.
The side door. On the far side of the lake, a ford once ran from the village to here. The water covers it now.
